site.title: Alex Morgan | Interior Designer & Visualizer
site.desc: Thoughtful interior design and realistic 3D visualisation for homes and workplaces.

hero.intro: I help homeowners and small businesses turn unclear ideas into calm, well-planned spaces. From first sketch to final render, every decision is explained and every detail is considered.

services.d: Layouts that make daily life easier and rooms feel larger.
services.long: Layouts that make daily life easier and rooms feel larger. Each plan starts with how you move through and use the space, then tests different arrangements before one is chosen.

services.d: Realistic renders so you can see the result before building.
services.long: Realistic renders so you can see the result before building. Materials, lighting and furniture are shown together, so decisions can be made with confidence.

services.d: A clear design direction built around how you live and work.
services.long: A clear design direction built around how you live and work. You see the style, colours and materials explained before detailed planning begins.

services.d: Complete design for apartments, houses and renovations.
services.long: Complete design for apartments, houses and renovations. The work covers each room so the whole home feels consistent and comfortable.

services.d: Layered lighting that sets the mood and supports each task.
services.long: Layered lighting that sets the mood and supports each task. Light is planned together with the layout and finishes rather than added at the end.

services.d: Furniture, finishes and decor chosen to work as one set.
services.long: Furniture, finishes and decor chosen to work as one set. Choices stay within your budget and are organised so nothing gets lost along the way.

aboutpage.p: A little about who I am and how I like to work with the people I design for.
aboutpage.lead: I believe a space should feel like it was made for the person who lives in it.
paras: I start by listening. Before I draw anything, I want to understand how you move through your day, what you enjoy about your space and what gets in the way. Those small details shape every decision that follows.

I plan clearly and explain my thinking. You will always know why a layout, a material or a colour has been chosen, and you are welcome to question it. Good design should make sense to the person who lives with it.
I like to show the result before it is built. Realistic 3D previews let us test ideas, adjust them and agree on a direction together, so there are fewer surprises later on.
Whether it is a single room or a whole home, I aim for the same thing: spaces that feel calm, work well and stay true to you rather than to a passing trend.
